name: Talkdesk
one_line: Customer-facing AI agent that resolves requests and completes tasks across voice, digital and email channels, handing over to a human agent when needed.

next_unlock.needs: Public evidence that agents operate across organisational boundaries or disparate stacks; and that others build on it: third parties publish integrations, skills or agents for it.

gamma_ray.fact_ray: 12 facts: 12 π Moderate. Each is written beside its evidence above.
gamma_ray.built_from: Talkdesk's own public pages (product, documentation, blog, customer stories, legal and security pages)

configs.what: Talkdesk Autopilot (AI Agents for voice, digital and email) with its documented defaults.
Talkdesk CXA Operations Center, a separate CXA product for observability, evaluation and guardrails of AI agents in production.
The Talkdesk and UiPath integration over MCP; needs the customer to run UiPath as well.

facts.label: It works across several domains or systems
facts.fact: Autopilot for email executes tasks such as processing refunds, re-routing shipments and managing appointments through integrations with CRM and ERP systems.
facts.quote: By integrating with your CRM and ERP, Autopilot executes tasks

facts.label: The agent has full autonomy within boundaries; the person monitors
facts.fact: Under the page heading Resolve requests autonomously with Talkdesk Autopilot, the page says that with CXA Operations Center people monitor live interactions, inspect execution behavior and enforce guardrails.
facts.quote: Monitor live interactions, inspect execution behavior, and enforce guardrails

facts.label: It connects to external tools or services across a trust boundary
facts.fact: Talkdesk states that its AI agents use MCP to call external tools and services of third parties.
facts.quote: securely discover, invoke, and exchange information with external tools and services

facts.label: A limit on it is a rule in prose
facts.fact: The press release gives a sample natural-language setup prompt for an AI agent that includes a rule to escalate to a live agent on a medical emergency.
facts.quote: Escalate to a live agent if the customer mentions a medical emergency

facts.label: Its purpose and permitted tasks are stated in writing
facts.fact: The product page states what Autopilot is for: resolving customer requests and completing tasks across channels.
facts.quote: agentic AI that resolves customer requests and completes tasks across voice and digital channels

facts.label: The data it uses is described
facts.fact: The product page names Talkdesk Data Cloud as the data AI Agents use to understand interaction history, intent and sentiment.
facts.quote: Leverage the Talkdesk Data Cloud so AI Agents understand history, intent, and sentiment

help.label: Our hypothesis, not their claim. Built from public pages only; nothing of theirs was tested.
help.pitch: RiskMandate would measure, for one real deployment of Talkdesk's agents, what each agent was asked to do (its mandate), what its credentials and connections actually let it reach (its grant), and the difference between the two (the gap), and keep that as a written record. It is read-only: never in the request path.

items.title: Check and claim the GAMMA-Ray card
items.text: The card is beta and read only from public pages; Talkdesk has not reviewed it. A correction is dated and published, and a file at /.well-known/fact-ray.json on their own domain raises the trust of every fact on it.

items.title: Measure one deployment
items.text: Pick one agent in one deployment; RiskMandate records its mandate, its grant and the gap, read-only. The lens page explains the measurement.

items.title: Run one of their agents under a harness, on stage
items.text: The same task run bare and under one policy, with the probes and the record public, as in our own harness runs (simulated data only).
